title: ドラマチックロード 風の発端
description:
■A Simulation RPG Set in Modern-Day Japan!The game takes place in Kanagawa, Japan, in the present day. All of the characters are ordinary students and working adults—realistic, everyday people. Instead of swords and magic, they fight with motorcycles and their fists in this unique Simulation RPG.

■A Simultaneous-Turn Battle System Where Allies and Enemies Act in Any Order!The game features a unique “Simultaneous Turn” system, where the action order of allies and enemies is constantly mixed together. You’ll need both split-second decision-making and long-term strategic thinking to overcome your opponents in this fresh take on the strategy genre.

 ■“Shift Change” ― The Key to Victory!“Shift Change” is a forbidden command that lets you move your units regardless of the current action order. Whether you use it to create an opening or turn the tide of a desperate situation is entirely up to you.

 

■Rewind Your Actions!The game features a “Rewind” function that lets you undo your actions by up to nine moves. Take your time, experiment, and carefully develop the best strategy for each situation.

■Over 30 Diverse Playable Characters!Meet a wide variety of characters, including bikers, baseball players, martial artists, therapists, and more. Build your team around each character’s unique personality and abilities.

■Countless Skills and Actions!As they grow, each character learns unique skills and actions that reflect their individual personalities. You can also freely customize your characters by adding and upgrading their actions.

■Strengthen Your Team Through Funding and Free Maps!Use the “Enhance Team” command to invest funds and strengthen your entire team. You can also take on Free Maps as many times as you like to further develop your team.

■A Deep Story Spanning 41 Stages!Experience the three-year struggle of ordinary people through a three-part story spanning 41 stages. Enjoy the intense and passionate drama of these young men and women as their lives collide in a fierce battle.

description_short: A full-fledged SRPG set in modern-day Japan! Use your allies' skills and special abilities to fight through simultaneous turn-based, strategic battles! A story of fierce battles between boys and girls told in three parts!
